results.change_intent: Make the content field optional when parsing unified completion message objects.
results.summary: Making content optional in the parser will cause a NullPointerException during transport serialization because Message's Writeable methods were not updated to handle null content.

issues.comment: Making the content field optional allows Message.content() to be null. However, Message's Writeable serialization has not been updated: Message(StreamInput in) uses in.readNamedWriteable(Content.class) (line 151) and Message#writeTo uses out.writeNamedWriteable(content). Calling out.writeNamedWriteable with a null content will throw a NullPointerException, and in.readNamedWriteable cannot deserialize a null value when messages are transmitted across cluster nodes.
issues.suggestion: Update Message(StreamInput in) to use in.readOptionalNamedWriteable(Content.class) and Message#writeTo to use out.writeOptionalNamedWriteable(content). In addition, annotate Content content with @Nullable in the Message record header.

results.change_intent: Handle null message content when serializing chat completion requests for OpenAI.
results.summary: Safely handles null message content by omitting the content field in the serialized OpenAI request.

results.change_intent: Remove tests that asserted an exception is thrown when message content is missing or null.
results.summary: Removes outdated tests that expected errors on missing content now that null content is permitted.
